purpose: Adversarial training cases for source identity, provenance, exact option and normative exception gates
prohibited_overclaim: Deterministic data-QA fixture pass is not a model benchmark, ANRE scored key or authorizing release

cases.name: Source spreadsheet object drawings are not blank
cases.source: Excel Sheet1 A35:D35 / drawing1.xml Group 551 / 22 OOXML shapes
cases.expected: Find linked drawing group and preserve original fault topology; reject hallucinated generic schematic; B only candidate

cases.name: Same question but altered options reverse exam candidate letter
cases.source: Original 2023 workbook rows 55 and 79 versus I7 2023 §§5.4.13 and 5.5.2.3
cases.negative_input: Import the trainer A/B barem as if source workbook A/B were identical
cases.expected: Reject source QABC identity, keep original C as source-supported candidate and trainer modified A/B separately, demand qualified signoff

cases.name: Same options but altered enunciation changes technical scope
cases.negative_input: Treat adimensională and caracteristică as synonyms
cases.expected: Record original stem vs rewritten stem, inverse-length propagation unit trap; never call exact duplicate

cases.name: Physical mechanism in an option materially modified
cases.negative_input: Treat electromagnetic induction and electrostatic induction as literal original-option synonyms
cases.expected: Mark modified B in both grade IDs; preserve original candidate dispute and technical mechanism

cases.name: Question from bibliography does not prove official sample origin
cases.source: V140 153 no-stem-match across five source examples
cases.negative_input: Label derived training question 'verbatim official ANRE exam sample' because source is official syllabus
cases.expected: Segregate as DIDACTIC_OR_UNVERIFIED_OFFICIAL_ORIGIN, independently audit technical answer, no claim excluded from every possible historical ANRE publication

cases.name: Numeric zero must be preserved in source worksheet parser
cases.source: 2024 Electro workbook row 161 contains numeric option 0
cases.negative_input: Use Python str(cell or '') before matching, thus turning 0 into missing
cases.expected: Preserve 0 as value; no false source mismatch; re-run strict normalization before counting

cases.name: Rule prohibition has exact source exceptions
cases.negative_input: Conclude tensile forces forbidden universally with zero exceptions
cases.expected: Read adjacent text: two exceptions; classify exam general rule vs universal technical truth, preserve imported key until approval

cases.name: Cross-grade exact QABC has different imported keys
cases.source: 2024 workbook rows 25 and 109 have no graded key column
cases.negative_input: Use an unlabelled source workbook A/B/C text to certify one imported key as official
cases.expected: Keep key conflict open, distinguish physical candidate from official scored key, demand independent review
